title: On Spec R the free module of rank n is the sheaf associated to R^n (Stacks 01HV(1)-(2), 01I7)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $n\ge0$, and let $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ be the free $\mathcal O_X$-module of rank $n$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with basis sections $e_1,\dots,e_n\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n})$. For an $R$-module $N$ let $\widetilde N$ with $\tau_X:N\to\Gamma(X,\widetilde N)$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Then there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\widetilde{R^{n}}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ sending $\tau_X(e_i)$ to $e_i$ ($e_i$ the standard basis of $R^n$). In particular $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n})=R^n$, with $e_i$ the standard basis.
